name: Ascot Valley Foods
old_description: Ascot specializes in round and formed frozen products, including appetizers and bite-sized formats. Our experience in shaping and forming allows us to support consistent sizing, texture, and performance across production runs. While our focus remains intentionally narrow, this specialization enables us to deliver reliable results within a profitable and scalable product niche.
about:
Ascot Valley Foods operates from Cuyahoga Falls, Ohio. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its website notes over 80 years of experience in food creation. No founders are named.

The company specializes in round and formed frozen products, including appetizers and bite-sized formats, leveraging shaping and forming expertise to deliver consistent sizing, texture, and performance across production runs. It provides contract frozen food manufacturing and private label solutions, with in-house capabilities spanning product development, raw material sourcing, labeling, process engineering, and packaging. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

Ascot serves food manufacturing companies across private label, retail, distribution, and broker channels, with a focus on the "Better For You" market. Its customer base ranges from start-ups to national brands, including private label customers, restaurant chains, co-packing clients, and broadline distributors. The company also supports vegetarian, vegan, and non-GMO product lines.

Ascot differentiates itself through its all-in-house model, which it says enables fast turnarounds, and its SQF Excellent Rating. Its narrow specialization in formed frozen products is presented as a deliberate strategy to ensure reliable, scalable results within a profitable niche.
